Comparison of the Three Concepts Send multiple pieces of data name, age, course Function as Props Send a function/action Provide fallback values 29. Real-World Example Imagine an Event Registration Application. The parent component has event information: It sends this information to an EventCard component. eventName="Tech Fest" eventDate="20 September" eventLocation="Mysore" The parent can also send a registration function: eventName="Tech Fest" onRegister={registerEvent} The child displays the event and provides a Register button. When the button is clicked, the child calls: onRegister(eventName); The parent receives the event name.
